notes: This sheet is drawn ROTATED: north is to the LEFT of the page (compass), so Pullan Avenue runs down the page (centre x~4916 at y 300 to ~5943 at y 7400, gently curved, no sharp bend) and the streets north of Pullan come in from the page-left. 'FERGUS' and 'LANGLAND' are printed bare; written with Street. Rodney Avenue is labelled 'RODNEY AV. (NOT OPEN)', 60'; it runs off the top of the page (real east) and meets Fergus at an L-corner: neither street continues (block 3's rear line closes the west side, the vacant block 2 beyond is unmapped). Recorded as T at the crossing of the two centrelines (3295,3138); the drawn corner of block 3 is chamfered, so that point sits ~26 px inside the block outline. Fergus (50') runs from that corner across Pullan and on to the right edge (that leg is Fergus on sheet 634). Beech Hill Avenue (50') runs from the left paper edge to Pullan; opposite it, across Pullan, a 12' alley (the Williamson-Fergus block alley of sheet 633, offset ~78 px) runs to the right edge. Williamson Place comes in from the page-right (south of Pullan) and ends at Pullan. A second 12' alley (the Langland-Williamson block alley of sheet 633) meets Pullan from the page-right. Langland (50') crosses Pullan; north of Pullan it zigzags (rising leg, ~100 px flat apex, descending leg: 3 bends) and leaves the left paper edge. Alley 1: 15' alley parallel to Pullan in the block between Rodney and Pullan, from Fergus to the top paper edge (continues off the sheet). Chambers (printed 50', 'CHAMBERS' at the top right) meets Pullan from the page-right at the very top: only one face (y~185 at x 5090) is on the paper and the pipe at y~120 suggests a narrow drawn width, so its centre is uncertain (somewhere between y~0 and ~110) and Chambers/Pullan is not recorded here (sheet 634 has it). Blocks 2, 4 and 5 are vacant ('No exposure').
